parsed.explanation: Decriminalisation of sodomy does not protect trans visitors. Morality/indecency provisions are documented as used against cross-dressing and gender-nonconforming presentation, carrying arrest, short imprisonment, fines and deportation for non-citizens. Entry screening targeting suspected effeminate persons is traveler-facing and raises discovery probability. Independent research is blocked, so thin data must extrapolate from hostile state machinery, religious-code enforcement, lack of protections and absence of any LGBTQ organisations or recourse. No documented execution, systematic torture, facility bans or custody sexual violence, so it is not at the absolute severe extreme. Resident LGR denial is not counted as visitor protection/penalty except as institutional climate. Overall state-directed targeting with limited severe penalties but weak remedy puts risk at the severe/high boundary.
